footer.tagline: A public-interest platform for documenting important incidents while keeping public reporting anonymous.

home.title: Document what happened.
home.description: RukheDao helps communities document important incidents through anonymous reporting, careful review, verification, and public records.
home.anonymousTitle: Your identity is not the story.
home.noAccountText: Public reporting does not require a profile or public login.
home.noIdentityText: The public reporting model does not store reporter identity fields.
home.noTrackingText: RukheDao is designed around anonymous public reporting rather than user profiles.
home.privacyFirstText: Learn what information the platform collects and how anonymous reporting works.
home.howItWorksTitle: From a report to a public record.
home.stepOneDescription: Submit the information needed to understand an incident without creating a public account.
home.stepTwoDescription: A submitted incident can be reviewed and, when needed, corrected or redacted.
home.stepThreeDescription: A separate verification status communicates how the incident has been assessed.
home.stepFourDescription: Approved incidents can become public records and remain traceable through revisions.
home.noRecentIncidents: No published incidents are available yet.
home.ctaDescription: Submit an anonymous report and help build a clearer public record.

incidents.description: Explore public records that have been reviewed and approved for publication.
incidents.publishedCount: {count, plural, =1 {# published incident} other {# published incidents}}
incidents.emptyDescription: Approved and published incidents will appear here.

incident.publicRecord: This is a public incident record.
incident.reportTitle: Report a problem with this record
incident.reportDescription: If this record is inaccurate, duplicates another record, creates a privacy concern, or contains harmful content, you can flag it anonymously for review.
incident.reportSuccess: Your anonymous report has been received for review.
incident.reportError: We could not submit the report. Please check the information and try again.

report.metaDescription: Submit an anonymous incident report to RukheDao.
report.title: Report an incident
report.description: Share the facts needed to document an important incident. No public account is required.
report.privacyDescription: Do not include your name, phone number, email address, or other information that could identify you unless it is necessary for understanding the incident.
report.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the incident with dates, places, people involved, and other relevant facts.
report.checkOne: Focus on observable facts and relevant details.
report.checkTwo: Avoid unnecessary personal or identifying information.
report.checkThree: Only submit information you are comfortable making part of a public-interest record if approved.
report.successDescription: Your report has been received for review.
report.referenceErrorHelp: Please refresh this page and try again.

admin.editIncidentHelp: Redact personal names, numbers, or sensitive content. This creates an auditable revision.
